title: Ichi the Killer
review: A series of excuses for creative torture and dismemberment scenes, strung together loosely in something like a noir detective format. The practical gore scenes have aged considerably better than the CGI ones. The plot moves very slowly and is not interesting enough for the film to hang around in my memory, at least not for any reason other than the gore visuals. It comes from a time where Japanese manga writers all seemed to be shy men with an unhealthy shame and anxiety about their own sexual arousal, and it's reflected in their work.
spoilers: Ichi uses the jugular too often. There are other parts he could have chopped with those killing shoes, to keep things fresh.
